sun.surface_redshift.description: Gravitational redshift z from the solar surface to infinity

sun.surface_redshift_velocity_equivalent.description: c*z for the solar surface redshift (about 636 m/s)

sun.embedding_slope_at_surface.description: Slope dw/dr of Flamm's paraboloid at the solar surface

neutron_star_example.surface_redshift.description: Surface redshift of a 1.4 solar-mass, 12 km neutron star (model)

schwarzschild.redshift_at_3rs.description: z from r = 3 r_s (ISCO) to infinity

schwarzschild.proper_distance_rs_to_3rs_.description: Proper radial distance from r_s to 3 r_s

schwarzschild.proper_distance_2rs_to_10r.description: Proper radial distance from 2 r_s to 10 r_s

schwarzschild.coordinate_light_time_2rs_.description: Coordinate time (observer at infinity) for radial light from 2 r_s to 10 r_s, times c

schwarzschild.flamm_height_2rs_to_10rs_i.description: Rise of Flamm's paraboloid from 2 r_s to 10 r_s (embedding condition integrated)

schwarzschild.radar_distance_from_2rs_to.description: Radar distance from a static observer at 2 r_s to 10 r_s (half the round-trip time on the observer's clock, times c)

schwarzschild.overhead_angle_ratio_at_2r.description: Angular size of a distant object overhead, seen by a static observer at 2 r_s, relative to no mass

schwarzschild.shadow_radius_in_rs.description: Apparent radius of a black hole's shadow seen from far away (critical impact parameter)

neutron_star_example.apparent_radius_km.description: Apparent radius of a 1.4 solar-mass, 12 km neutron star seen from far away (largest impact parameter of light leaving its surface)

sun.limb_light_deflection_arcsec.description: Light deflection grazing the solar limb (observed: 1.75 arcsec class)

mercury.perihelion_advance_arcsec_per_ce.description: GR perihelion advance of Mercury (Will 2014 quotes 42.98)
mercury.perihelion_advance_arcsec_per_ce.source: Astropy constants (CODATA 2018, IAU 2015 nominal values); JPL orbital elements

gps.gravitational_rate_us_per_day.description: GPS clock gain from weaker gravity (simplified model)
gps.gravitational_rate_us_per_day.source: Astropy constants (CODATA 2018, IAU 2015 nominal values); Ashby 2003 orbit

gps.velocity_rate_us_per_day.description: GPS clock loss from orbital speed (simplified model)
gps.velocity_rate_us_per_day.source: Astropy constants (CODATA 2018, IAU 2015 nominal values); Ashby 2003 orbit

gps.net_rate_us_per_day.description: Net GPS clock gain per day (simplified; published figure is about 38 us/day)
gps.net_rate_us_per_day.source: Astropy constants (CODATA 2018, IAU 2015 nominal values); Ashby 2003 orbit

pound_rebka.fractional_shift.description: Predicted fractional frequency shift g h / c^2 over 22.5 m

cosmology.recombination_redshift.description: Redshift of last scattering z* (verify against Planck 2018 VI Table 2)

cosmology.age_at_recombination_kyr.description: Age of the universe at z*

cosmology.comoving_distance_to_recombina.description: Comoving distance to the last-scattering surface

cosmology.particle_horizon_comoving_gly.description: Comoving radius of the observable universe (integrated to z = 1e10)

cosmology.redshift_of_max_emission_dista.description: z where proper distance at emission (D_A) is largest

units.million_light_years_per_megaparsec.description: Megaparsec in millions of light-years (IAU parsec, Julian-year light-year)
